$Comment: Names the restless graveyard's best wave for lock lines, so an achievement gated on it reads 'Requires a best wave in the Restless Graveyard of 10 (currently 6)' instead of the generic line. The gate is ziggfreedcommon:counter with the Param below: Dungeon_Best_Wave, ziggfreed-common's stat for the most waves a player cleared in one endless run, on the line it keeps for this dungeon at normal difficulty (dungeon:@ and the dungeon's id). The Keys entry spells that Param exactly as the gates write it and points at a full lang key: the lang file's name, a dot, then the key as written in seasonsoforbis.lang.
